targets.review_note: Perform expression-tree knapsack indexed by the count of the rarer operator, bounded by min(P,M)<=100. For each exact count retain both minimum and maximum attainable subtree values; subtraction combines left maximum with right minimum, or left minimum with right maximum. Enumerate operator and child count splits at each merge. Parse the fully parenthesized expression iteratively on closing parentheses, avoiding depth limits on skew trees. The complementary operator count follows automatically from each subtree size, so tracking only the rarer count loses no constraint.
